1. tests/test_vfx_picker.py::VfxPickerTests::test_headless_tab_twice_cast_scene_labels_and_inflight_kit_lock — picker_probe.gd exits 7: `T3O_PICKER={"bolt_paths":["res://scenes/vfx/g1_projectile.tscn","res://scenes/vfx/g1_projectile.tscn"],"errors":2,...}` then `T3O_ASSERTION: target collision` and `T3O_ASSERTION: in-flight impact kit lock`. The synthetic fixture's target is NOT a `target`-tagged prop instance; T4f's contact/pierce path no longer registers collision against it, so the impact never spawns and the in-flight kit lock is never exercised.
2. tests/test_vfx_picker.py::AuthoredEffectPickerTests::test_headless_authored_cast_east_north_collision_timing_and_feedback_cleanup — effect_probe.gd hangs to the 60 s timeout (a head that never contacts never expires/cleans up in that fixture).

Do NOT touch the two fixtures' expectations to make them pass — fix the runtime. Re-run those two tests + tests/test_vfx_picker.py + tests/test_effect_kit.py (headless tests may be red INSIDE the sandbox — note it) and the 33-file kit byte-lock check; then the full suite `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` (standing reds: test_synthetic_contract_and_grid + the four T0-d3 motif reds only).
